cell_identity: Samsung-labelled 18650 ICR "4000 mAh" 3.7 V cell as tested by the BMS team; electrical model and capacity from Nancy Zayour and Nagham El Ghossein pulse characterization (investigator instruction 2026-11-06; relabelling accepted).
cell_capacity_source: Nancy manuscript (References/battery-manuscript.tex): 2 Ah nominal; 0.5C 6-minute pulses each remove 5% SOC from 100% to 5% with OCV reaching 3.03 V, i.e. about 1.9 Ah measured to 5%, consistent with 2 Ah rather than the 4000 mAh label.
cell_table_policy: Nancy-characterized our params.xlsx OCV/3RC table and 2 Ah capacity used exactly as identified; no rescaling.
sizing_criterion: Series count 7 retained at the 0.66 m/s command cap: interval-level replay of the clean full 320 m tracked-swing mission at requested 0.58 m/s with the 2 Ah cell passes from 30%, 95% and 100% (minimum headroom 1.97/3.76/3.93 V; voltage feasible to the 20% floor) while 6S fails from every start. Full-speed (0.66 m/s) requests need ~30 V and are voltage-limited on 7S.
selection_evidence: Clean native trace BeyondTorque-Local-Artifacts/tracked-swing-plant-20261105-a (source f882feb, 4 Ah run; current and voltage are capacity-independent at equal SOC) replayed with the 2 Ah cell; native 2 Ah requalification pending.
